visual_events.label: Mason sets down empty pan, shapes a brick bat with trowel, and sets it at wall junction
visual_events.description: In an outdoor yard, lead mason (ent_mason) sets an empty metal mortar pan down onto the ground at right (00.0–01.8s) and picks up his trowel (ent_trowel). He scrapes mortar on the inner T-junction of the low brick-on-edge wall (ent_wall_demo) (02.0–03.5s), picks up a half-brick bat in his left hand (03.8s), and strikes/trims it repeatedly with the blade of his trowel (04.5–07.2s) while helper 1 (ent_helper_1) stands at right. The mason places the trimmed brick piece into the junction, adjusts it, and taps it down with the trowel (07.5–11.2s).
visual_events.context_result: Trimmed brick bat is seated at the inner wall junction.
visual_events.camera_framing: Static tripod medium-wide high-angle shot looking down at the low L/T-shaped brick structure.

visual_events.label: Helper replenishes mortar pan while mason applies mortar to junction and cross-wall
visual_events.description: Overlapping the end of ve_01, older helper (ent_helper_1) bends down at right to pick up a mortar pan (08.5–10.5s), pours grey mortar into the mason's foreground pan (11.5–15.5s), and walks out of frame right (16.0–17.0s). Meanwhile, the mason uses his trowel and hand to pack and smooth mortar around the junction brick and internal joint (11.2–18.5s), then reaches down to the refilled pan at right to scoop fresh mortar (19.0–20.8s) and spreads it onto the top edge of the projecting stub wall (21.0–21.8s).
visual_events.context_result: Foreground mortar pan is refilled and initial mortar bed is placed on the stub wall.

visual_events.label: Mason lays brick on edge on stub wall while second helper delivers two bricks
visual_events.description: The mason positions the brick on edge along the inner stub wall, buttering and tucking mortar into the vertical and horizontal joints with his trowel and left hand to align the face flush with the course below (21.8–28.5s). He reaches to the mortar pan at right (28.8–30.2s) just as a second helper (ent_helper_2) enters from the right carrying two bricks (30.0–32.5s), sets them on the ground near the pan, and steps back to the right edge (33.0–34.5s). Meanwhile the mason applies and trims mortar along the laid brick on edge (30.5–34.5s).
visual_events.context_result: Brick on edge is bedded and aligned on the stub wall; two fresh bricks are placed on the ground at right.

visual_events.label: Mason points and packs mortar into joints at the wall junction while helper gestures from right edge
visual_events.description: The mason scoops mortar from the pan at right (35.5–37.2s) and applies it carefully into the top and side joints of the brick-on-edge stub wall and junction, smoothing and scraping excess mortar with his trowel (37.5–42.8s). At the right edge of the frame, the second helper's hand gestures briefly toward the wall (37.8–42.0s) while speaking off-screen (sp_01). The mason scoops another trowel of mortar from the pan (43.0–45.0s), spreads and packs it across the junction bricks to seal the gaps around the cavities (45.2–50.5s), and bends down toward the mortar pan again as the clip ends (50.8–51.84s).
visual_events.context_result: Mortar joints at the T-junction and stub wall are packed and smoothed; mason is mid-reach toward the mortar pan at clip end.
